description.zh:
初始账号名称，限制如下：

- 由小写字母，数字，下划线组成。
- 以小写字母开头，小写字母或数字结尾。
- 不能以gp开头。
- 长度为2~16个字符。
description.en:
The name of the initial account. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
- The name must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
- The name cannot start with gp.
- The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length.

description.zh:
实例ID。
>支持传入最多30个实例ID进行批量操作，用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en:
The instance ID.
>You can specify up to 30 instance IDs for batch operations. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-account --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --account-name testuser --region cn-hangzhou
